problems.message: no to:, so any program can receive this secret; name the receiver with to:
managed clusters can't trust a nazar CA (their client CA can't be changed); this context will not work there
secret NOTES is configured but not stored; run `nazar secret add NOTES`
context hydra.eks has no CA, so kubectl gets nothing for it; run `nazar k8s forget hydra.eks`, then `nazar k8s ca create hydra.eks`
